scripts.typecheck: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm build && pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm build && pnpm openapi:check && vitest run --exclude '**/*.integration.test.ts'
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm build && playwright test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm build && node scripts/run-database-integration.mjs
scripts.quality: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.db:generate: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm --filter @damdai/config build && pnpm --filter @damdai/database db:generate
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm --filter @damdai/config build && pnpm --filter @damdai/database db:migrate
scripts.research-schema:check: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm --filter @damdai/contracts research-schema:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/generated/research-request.json packages/contracts/generated/research-response.json packages/contracts/generated/research-error.json
scripts.openapi:check: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm --filter @damdai/api openapi:generate && pnpm --filter @damdai/contracts research-schema:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/generated/openapi.json packages/contracts/generated/research-request.json packages/contracts/generated/research-response.json packages/contracts/generated/research-error.json
